summary: Iter107 — Bilingual coverage audit (EN→ES UI translation + ES→EN auto-translate on submit). Backend: 5/5 tests PASSED. /api/translate ES→EN works correctly for non-empty strings, short-circuits for empty input, and gracefully handles empty values. End-to-end ES round-trip on /api/field-leadership (write_up) and /api/public/time-off/{token}/submit both persist English text in description/corrective_action/coverage_plan/notes after a translate+POST. Frontend: ES toggle works and PERSISTS across navigation via localStorage 'masci.lang'. Confirmed ES wiring on /, /field, /safety, /qaqc, /leadership (back-link, tile titles + CTAs translate on sub-hubs). FINDING: Multiple ES translation gaps remain on Hub.jsx (/) — section group headers, section subheaders, tile CTAs and portal/reference tile descriptions still render in English when ES is active. /leadership and /qaqc back-link still says 'HUB' (not 'Inicio'). /leadership login page still uses the legacy 'MASCI HUB' wordmark lockup image in the header (iter106 P1 branding regression persists on this sub-route — main / has been updated to M-mark, /leadership has not).

minor.issue: Frontend translateOnSubmit.js stamps 'submit_language' on the payload, but the FieldLeadershipCreate model only declares 'language'. Pydantic default Config drops extras silently, so the persisted record uses 'language' (which does get set correctly because frontend also passes language:'es'). NOT broken end-to-end, but the field name mismatch is fragile — recommend either adding 'submit_language: Optional[str] = None' to the model OR documenting that 'language' is the canonical field.

ui_bugs.issue: When ES is active, section labels still render in English: 'Today in the Field', 'Leadership Tools', 'Office Portals', 'Reference'. Their sub-text lines also untranslated ('Submissions every crew on site needs today.', 'For foremen, supervisors, and superintendents in the field.', 'Sign-in required. For office staff, mechanics, and HR.', 'Always available — no sign-in needed.').
Campo / QA·QC / Seguridad tiles show 'ENTER →' in ES mode. Should be the Spanish equivalent (e.g., 'ENTRAR →' or use the 'Open Hub' key).
ui_bugs.selector: Hub.jsx primary tile CTAs (the 3 top operational tiles)

ui_bugs.issue: Portal PM / Taller / HR Portal / Admin tile descriptions stay English in ES mode ('The project-management workspace for MASCI office...', 'The mechanic\u2019s console for the MASCI equipment fleet.', 'Employee records and payroll cross-check for MASCI HR.', 'The MASCI office console.'). The 'INICIAR SESIÓN' CTA does translate.

'Need Help?', 'Office phone, address, and after-hours contact.', 'Short bilingual lessons for every role.', 'The one-pager pinned in every site trailer.' all stay English in ES mode (Centro de Capacitación + Hoja de Referencia titles DO translate).
Button text stays 'SIGN IN' in ES mode. Should translate to 'INICIAR SESIÓN'.
Back-link text reads 'HUB' (English) instead of 'Inicio' (Spanish) when ES is active. /field and /safety correctly say 'INICIO'.
ui_bugs.selector: back-link anchor on QaqcSection.jsx and FieldLeadershipHub.jsx (and gate page)

ui_bugs.issue: Header still uses the legacy full 'MASCI HUB' wordmark lockup image ('NO GUESSWORK · NO MISSED STEPS · NO EXCUSES'). The iter106 P1 branding rebrand was applied to / (now shows M-mark only) but NOT to /leadership gate page. Spec requires M-mark only on user-facing surfaces.

action_items: P1: Swap /leadership gate page header image from full 'MASCI HUB' lockup to the M-mark variant used on / (iter106 carryover — only the / route was rebranded last iteration).
P2: Wire t() on Hub.jsx section group headers + their subtexts (the 4 sections 'Today in the Field', 'Leadership Tools', 'Office Portals', 'Reference').
P2: Replace the 3 'ENTER →' tile CTAs on Hub.jsx with t('Open Hub') or a new dedicated key.
P2: Wire t() on Portal tile descriptions + Reference tile descriptions in Hub.jsx.
P2: Wire t() on the 'Sign In' button in Hub.jsx header.
P2: Fix /qaqc and /leadership back-link to use t('Home') instead of hardcoded 'HUB' (FieldSection.jsx and SafetySection.jsx already do this correctly — copy the same pattern).

Optional cleanup: Add 'submit_language: Optional[str] = None' to FieldLeadershipCreate + PublicTimeOffSubmit models so the audit field is officially recognized (currently the language field carries the same intent).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend translate endpoint correctly returns 200 with same input on empty/identical-lang/missing-LLM-key paths — submit is never blocked.
Frontend translateOnSubmit.js correctly skips non-freeform fields via SKIP_KEY_RE (signatures, dates, photos, IDs) and walks nested details{} objects.
ES localStorage persistence works as documented — key is 'masci.lang' (not 'lang') and survives client-side navigation across all 5 hub routes.

/api/field-leadership round-trip verified: Spanish description+corrective_action translated to English and persisted, with language='es' on the record. Frontend stamps submit_language but Pydantic drops it (fine because language is set in parallel).
Public time-off /api/public/time-off/{token}/submit accepts Spanish coverage_plan/notes (after frontend translate), persists English, and stamps via the linked record.

success_rate.frontend: 70% — ES toggle + persistence + sub-hub coverage GREEN; Hub.jsx has 5+ untranslated zones; 2 back-links still hardcoded; /leadership gate header branding regression

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend translate + ES->EN persistence GREEN. After main agent fixes Hub.jsx t() coverage gaps + /qaqc/leadership back-link + /leadership gate header logo, re-run: (1) pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter107_bilingual_audit.py (5 tests, ~10s), (2) Playwright sweep of /, /field, /safety, /qaqc, /leadership in ES mode — body text should contain ZERO of: 'ENTER →', 'Today in the Field', 'Leadership Tools', 'Office Portals', 'Sign-in required', 'Need Help?', 'Sign In' (top-right button). Footer 'POWERED BY FORGEDOPS™' is intentional English. The 'MASCI HUB' wordmark must not appear on /leadership gate. ES persistence uses localStorage.masci.lang.
rca of the issue: Hub.jsx (the / landing) was rebuilt last iteration as a new 4-section layout, but the new section labels, sub-texts, tile CTAs and portal/reference descriptions were written as raw English strings instead of being wrapped in t(). Only the kicker, H1 and tile titles got the t() treatment. The pattern used in FieldSection.jsx/SafetySection.jsx (where everything translates correctly) was not replicated. /leadership gate page header was not touched in the iter106 rebrand sweep — it still imports/renders the legacy MASCI HUB lockup asset instead of pointing at the M-mark.
